articles.title: Trump-backed World Liberty Financial plans token buyback after 66% year-to-date slide
articles.snippet: The crypto venture may use fees from its USD1 stablecoin reserves to fund token purchases as it seeks to boost governance.

articles.title: American Bitcoin’s $126M profit masks mining pressure as rivals turn to AI
articles.snippet: The Eric Trump-backed miner reported $126 million in quarterly net income, largely driven by gains on its Bitcoin holdings, despite rising mining costs and shrinking margins.

articles.title: Trump-Backed American Bitcoin Turns a Profit as Bitcoin Rise Lifts Books
articles.snippet: The Hut 8-backed miner reversed a second-quarter loss, driven largely by a $197 million gain on its Bitcoin holdings.

articles.title: S&P 500 Plunges, Wall Street Fears Circuit Breaker, Just One Day After Trump Celebrated Record Highs
articles.snippet: A day after Trump celebrated stock market records, the S&P 500 sank 3.8%, putting emergency trading halts in focus as AI stocks dragged Wall Street sharply lower during Thursday trading.
